card.title: IPhone XR Rear camera is not working

source.title: IPhone XR Rear camera is not working

claims.statement: iPhone XR rear camera: try a known-good camera (flash an update if needed), diode-check the connector, then check camera LDO U1601; ZXW shows its pin 1 wrong, so match orientation to the actual board.

procedure: Try known-good rear camera and update.
Inspect/replace LDO U1601 with correct orientation.
cautions: SOURCE RISK: ZXW boardview shows U1601 pin 1 incorrectly.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
